author: Jisudeng
title: 白底电商主图
description: 适合淘宝、京东、拼多多、独立站商品首图，重点是真实、干净、突出商品。
promptZh: 生成一张标准电商白底主图。画面只展示一个核心商品，商品位于画面中心，比例真实，边缘清晰，主体占画面 70% 到 85%。背景为纯白或极浅灰无缝背景，地面只保留非常干净的自然接触阴影。商品材质必须真实可辨，例如金属反光、玻璃透明、布料纹理、塑料哑光或纸盒细节。光线为大型柔光箱棚拍效果，亮度均匀不过曝，轮廓清楚，不添加装饰道具，不生成任何品牌文字、价格、水印、二维码或促销贴纸。避免商品变形、重复商品、边缘抠图感、阴影脏乱和不真实反光。
promptEn: Create a standard e-commerce white-background hero image. Show only one core product centered in the frame, with realistic scale, crisp edges, and the product occupying 70% to 85% of the image. Use a pure white or very light gray seamless background with only a clean natural contact shadow on the ground. Product materials must be clearly recognizable, such as metal reflection, glass transparency, fabric texture, matte plastic, or paper packaging detail. Lighting should feel like a large softbox studio setup, evenly bright but not overexposed, with a clear silhouette. Do not add decorative props, brand text, prices, watermarks, QR codes, or promotion stickers. Avoid product distortion, duplicate products, cutout-looking edges, dirty shadows, and unrealistic reflections.
subject: product

author: Jisudeng
title: 小红书封面底图
description: 适合笔记封面、攻略封面、种草内容首图，预留中文标题空间。
promptZh: 生成一张小红书风格竖版封面底图。画面主体明确，可以是人物、产品、场景或生活方式物品，放在画面中上部或三分线位置。背景清爽但有层次，使用明亮自然光、柔和阴影和干净色彩，预留大块标题空间，不生成真实文字，只允许使用抽象占位块或留白。构图要适合手机信息流快速识别，第一眼能看清主题，颜色有吸引力但不廉价。适合后期添加中文大标题、标签和卖点。避免乱码文字、过度贴纸、拥挤元素、强烈磨皮和低质拼贴感。
promptEn: Create a vertical Xiaohongshu-style cover background. The subject should be clear, such as a person, product, scene, or lifestyle object, placed in the upper-middle area or near a rule-of-thirds point. The background should be fresh but layered, using bright natural light, soft shadows, and clean colors. Reserve a large headline area without generating real text; only abstract placeholder blocks or empty space are acceptable. The composition must be easy to recognize in a mobile feed, with the theme clear at first glance and attractive but not cheap colors. It should be suitable for adding Chinese headlines, tags, and selling points later. Avoid garbled text, excessive stickers, crowded elements, heavy skin smoothing, and low-quality collage effects.
subject: cover

author: Jisudeng
title: 直播间预告海报
description: 适合直播预热、活动预约、短视频直播入口视觉。
promptZh: 设计一张直播间预告海报底图。画面为竖版构图，中心展示主播、商品或活动主视觉，周围有清晰的舞台感灯光、直播氛围元素和可放置福利信息的区域。整体风格热闹但不杂乱，前景主体突出，背景有光效层次和空间深度。画面需要预留标题、直播时间、福利卖点和行动按钮区域，但不要生成可读文字，只使用空白区域或抽象占位形状。色彩要有促销氛围，适合移动端阅读。避免乱码文字、过度炫光、低质抠图、主体变形和拥挤小元素。
promptEn: Design a vertical livestream announcement poster background. Show a host, product, or campaign hero visual in the center, surrounded by clear stage-like lighting, livestream atmosphere elements, and areas where benefit information can be added later. The overall style should feel energetic but not messy, with a strong foreground subject, layered lighting, and spatial depth. Reserve areas for a title, livestream time, promotional benefits, and a call-to-action button, but do not generate readable text; use empty regions or abstract placeholder shapes only. Colors should feel promotional and readable on mobile. Avoid garbled text, excessive glare, poor cutout edges, distorted subjects, and crowded tiny elements.
subject: campaign

author: Jisudeng
title: 教育概念图解
description: 适合课程封面、知识科普、教学图解，画面不直接生成正文。
promptZh: 生成一张教育知识图解风格插画。主题围绕一个清晰概念，例如学习路径、知识结构、科学原理、职业技能或工具流程。画面使用模块化信息布局，包含中心主题图形、分支节点、箭头关系、图标和空白文字占位区，但不要生成真实可读文字。风格应简洁、可信、适合中文课程内容后期编辑。色彩使用浅底、清晰对比和少量强调色，保证移动端也能看清结构。避免复杂表格、乱码字、随机公式、拥挤布局和低龄卡通感。
promptEn: Create an educational concept infographic illustration. The theme should revolve around a clear concept such as a learning path, knowledge structure, scientific principle, professional skill, or tool workflow. Use a modular information layout with a central theme graphic, branch nodes, arrows, icons, and blank text placeholder areas, but do not generate real readable text. The style should be clean, credible, and suitable for later Chinese course editing. Use a light background, clear contrast, and a few accent colors so the structure remains readable on mobile. Avoid complex tables, garbled words, random formulas, crowded layout, and childish cartoon styling.
subject: infographic

author: Jisudeng
title: SaaS 产品界面展示
description: 适合官网首屏、功能页、产品介绍图，不生成真实品牌文字。
promptZh: 生成一张 SaaS 产品界面展示视觉。画面中有一个现代 Web Dashboard 界面，包含侧边导航、数据卡片、折线图、表格和操作面板，但所有文字都应为抽象占位线或不可读占位块。界面放置在干净的浅色或深浅结合背景中，透视轻微，层级清楚，像真实产品官网首屏图。视觉重点是信息密度、界面秩序、专业可信和可用性，不要做成炫酷但不可读的装饰图。避免乱码文字、真实品牌名、过度玻璃拟态、混乱阴影和无意义浮动卡片。
promptEn: Create a SaaS product interface showcase visual. Include a modern web dashboard with side navigation, data cards, line charts, tables, and operation panels, but all text must be abstract placeholder lines or unreadable blocks. Place the interface in a clean light or balanced light-dark background with slight perspective and clear hierarchy, like a real product website hero image. Focus on information density, interface order, professionalism, credibility, and usability rather than decorative spectacle. Avoid garbled text, real brand names, excessive glassmorphism, chaotic shadows, and meaningless floating cards.
subject: interface

author: Jisudeng
title: 移动 APP 功能界面
description: 适合 App 功能展示、应用商店截图、产品介绍页。
promptZh: 设计一张移动 APP 功能界面展示图。画面中显示一台或两台手机，屏幕展示真实可用的设置页、账户页、任务页或素材库页面结构。界面应为中文产品常见布局，但不要生成真实可读文字，只使用合理的占位条、图标、开关、卡片、列表和按钮位置。手机外观简洁，背景为干净品牌色或浅色工作台，光线柔和，边缘清晰。重点体现专业、稳定、好用，而不是营销海报。避免英文界面、乱码、过多装饰、按钮重叠和不合理手机比例。
promptEn: Design a mobile app feature interface showcase. Show one or two phones with screens displaying a realistic settings page, account page, task page, or material library structure. The interface should follow common Chinese mobile product layouts, but do not generate real readable text; use reasonable placeholder lines, icons, toggles, cards, lists, and button positions. The phone hardware should be simple, with a clean brand-color or light desk background, soft lighting, and crisp edges. Emphasize professionalism, stability, and usability rather than marketing decoration. Avoid English UI, garbled text, excessive ornament, overlapping buttons, and unrealistic phone proportions.
subject: mobile-interface

author: Jisudeng
title: 游戏道具图标组
description: 适合手游道具、装备、资源图标，强调统一风格和可识别性。
promptZh: 生成一组统一风格的游戏道具图标。画面展示 6 到 9 个独立道具，每个道具放在一致尺寸的透明或浅色格子中，包括药水、钥匙、宝石、卷轴、武器碎片、能量核心或金币袋等。图标需要轮廓清楚、材质可辨、小尺寸下仍能识别，光源方向一致，阴影统一。整体风格可以是精致 3D、手绘奇幻或休闲手游风，但必须保持同一套美术语言。不要生成文字、数字、真实品牌标识或复杂背景。避免图标风格不一致、细节过碎、边缘模糊和道具互相遮挡。
promptEn: Create a consistent set of game item icons. Show 6 to 9 separate items, each placed in an equal-size transparent or light grid cell, such as a potion, key, gem, scroll, weapon fragment, energy core, or coin pouch. Icons need clear silhouettes, recognizable materials, and readability at small size, with a unified light direction and consistent shadows. The overall style can be polished 3D, hand-painted fantasy, or casual mobile game art, but must stay within one coherent art language. Do not generate text, numbers, real brand marks, or complex backgrounds. Avoid inconsistent icon styles, overly tiny details, blurry edges, and items overlapping each other.
subject: icons

author: Jisudeng
title: 游戏角色立绘
description: 适合角色宣传图、抽卡立绘、游戏美术概念。
promptZh: 创作一张游戏角色宣传立绘。角色全身或 3/4 身位于画面中心，姿态有力量感但不夸张，服装、武器或配饰体现清晰职业设定，例如法师、战士、探险家、赛博特工或东方侠客。背景为简洁但有氛围的场景光效，不能抢主体。角色面部、手部、服装结构和装备细节要一致且可信。画面适合游戏宣传图或抽卡立绘，构图有视觉冲击力。不要生成文字、UI 按钮、低俗暴露、错误肢体、重复武器和杂乱背景。
promptEn: Create a game character splash illustration. Show a full-body or three-quarter character centered in the frame, with a powerful but not exaggerated pose. Clothing, weapons, or accessories should clearly express a class or role such as mage, warrior, explorer, cyber agent, or eastern swordsman. The background should be simple but atmospheric, with lighting that supports the subject without competing with it. Facial features, hands, clothing structure, and equipment details must remain consistent and credible. The composition should work for game promotion or character gacha splash art. Do not generate text, UI buttons, vulgar exposure, incorrect limbs, duplicated weapons, or messy backgrounds.
subject: character

author: Jisudeng
title: 动作漫画分镜
description: 适合短篇漫画、故事板、动作场景设计，不直接生成对白。
promptZh: 生成一页动作漫画分镜草图。页面包含 5 到 7 个分镜格，镜头依次表现：环境建立、角色准备、动作爆发、关键碰撞、表情特写、结果停顿和下一步悬念。每个分镜格之间留出清晰 gutter，人物造型保持一致，动作方向明确，速度线和构图引导视线。可以保留空白对白框位置，但不要生成真实文字。风格为干净黑白线稿或低饱和彩色草图，重点是节奏、镜头语言和动作可读性。避免角色变脸、肢体错误、画面拥挤、乱码文字和分镜顺序混乱。
promptEn: Create a one-page action comic storyboard sketch. Include 5 to 7 panels showing, in order: establishing environment, character preparation, action burst, key impact, expression close-up, aftermath pause, and a suspenseful next beat. Leave clear gutters between panels. Keep the character design consistent, action direction readable, and use speed lines and composition to guide the eye. Empty speech bubble areas are acceptable, but do not generate real text. Use clean black-and-white line art or low-saturation color sketch style, focusing on pacing, cinematic language, and action readability. Avoid changing character faces, incorrect limbs, crowded panels, garbled text, and confused panel order.
subject: storyboard

author: Jisudeng
title: 电影感产品镜头
description: 适合高端产品广告、短视频画面、品牌宣传图。
promptZh: 生成一张电影感产品广告剧照。产品放在真实场景中，例如车内中控、浴室台面、厨房岛台、户外露营桌或工作室桌面，周围只有少量与使用场景有关的道具。镜头使用浅景深和明确光源，主光塑造产品轮廓，环境光提供故事氛围。画面颜色克制，有高级广告质感，构图像短片中的关键帧。产品必须清楚可见，不被道具遮挡，材质真实。不要生成文字、Logo、夸张光效、过度虚化、脏乱背景或不合理尺寸比例。
promptEn: Create a cinematic product advertising still. Place the product in a real usage scene such as a car console, bathroom counter, kitchen island, outdoor camping table, or studio desk, with only a few relevant props. Use shallow depth of field and a clear light source: the key light shapes the product silhouette while ambient light adds story atmosphere. Colors should be restrained, with a premium advertising feel, composed like a key frame from a short film. The product must remain clearly visible, unobstructed, and materially realistic. Do not generate text, logos, exaggerated lighting effects, excessive blur, messy backgrounds, or unrealistic scale.
subject: product

author: Jisudeng
title: 房产客厅广角图
description: 适合房地产、民宿、装修案例展示，强调真实空间和动线。
promptZh: 生成一张真实房产客厅广角摄影。镜头位于人眼高度或略低位置，展示客厅、阳台或餐厨连接关系，空间动线清楚，家具比例正确。室内有自然采光，窗外不过曝，墙面、地面、沙发、窗帘和灯具材质真实。画面干净整洁但有生活温度，适合房源展示或装修案例。构图需要横向宽幅，避免鱼眼变形。不要过度豪华化，不要错误透视，不要变形家具，不要随机文字标牌，不要不合理的门窗结构。
promptEn: Create a realistic wide-angle real estate living room photograph. Use an eye-level or slightly lower camera height to show the relationship between the living room, balcony, dining area, or kitchen, with clear circulation and correct furniture scale. The room should have natural daylight, with windows not overexposed, and realistic wall, floor, sofa, curtain, and lighting materials. The scene should be tidy yet warm, suitable for property listings or interior case studies. Use a horizontal wide composition while avoiding fisheye distortion. Do not over-luxurize the space, create wrong perspective, distorted furniture, random signage, or impossible door and window structures.
subject: interior

author: Jisudeng
title: 咖啡店空间氛围
description: 适合门店宣传、空间设计、生活方式品牌图。
promptZh: 生成一张精品咖啡店室内氛围摄影。空间包含吧台、座位区、暖色灯光、木质或石材材质、植物或小型装饰，整体干净有秩序。镜头展示顾客视角的空间体验，画面中可以有少量模糊人物作为氛围，但主体是空间和品牌气质。光线为自然光与室内暖光混合，色彩温暖但不过黄。画面适合门店宣传和社媒配图。不要生成真实招牌文字、菜单文字、拥挤人群、杂乱桌面、错误透视或过度滤镜。
promptEn: Create a boutique cafe interior atmosphere photograph. The space includes a counter, seating area, warm lighting, wood or stone materials, plants, or small decor, all clean and orderly. The camera should show the customer experience of the space; a few softly blurred people may appear for atmosphere, but the main subject is the interior and brand feeling. Lighting should mix natural daylight with warm indoor light, with colors warm but not overly yellow. The image should work for store promotion and social media. Do not generate real signage text, menu text, crowded people, messy tables, wrong perspective, or heavy filters.
subject: interior

author: Jisudeng
title: 套餐俯拍美食图
description: 适合外卖套餐、菜单、餐饮品牌宣传。
promptZh: 生成一张套餐美食俯拍摄影。主餐、配菜、饮品和餐具在桌面上形成清晰布局，主体餐品最大，配菜围绕但不抢画面。食物颜色真实诱人，质感干净，能看清主要食材层次。背景可以是浅色餐桌、木桌或石材台面，保留适度留白用于后期添加套餐名和价格，但不要生成真实文字。光线柔和自然，阴影方向统一。避免食物变形、过度油腻、桌面杂乱、餐具比例错误、乱码文字和不真实饱和度。
promptEn: Create an overhead meal set food photograph. Arrange the main dish, side dishes, drink, and tableware in a clear layout, with the main dish largest and side items supporting without stealing attention. Food colors should be realistic and appetizing, with clean texture and visible ingredient layers. The background can be a pale dining table, wooden table, or stone surface, leaving moderate blank space for adding a meal name and price later, but do not generate real text. Lighting should be soft and natural with consistent shadow direction. Avoid distorted food, excessive grease, messy tables, incorrect tableware scale, garbled text, and unrealistic saturation.
subject: food

author: Jisudeng
title: 服装穿搭平铺
description: 适合穿搭推荐、电商详情、社媒种草。
promptZh: 生成一张服装穿搭平铺摄影。上衣、裤装或裙装、鞋包配饰在干净背景上按完整穿搭逻辑摆放，衣物褶皱自然，面料纹理清楚，颜色搭配协调。画面使用俯拍或轻微斜俯拍，留出适当空白方便后期添加中文标签，但不要生成真实文字。光线柔和均匀，阴影轻，整体像品牌 Lookbook 或电商搭配图。避免衣物变形、袖口领口错误、配饰比例不合理、杂乱背景、随机文字和过度滤镜。
promptEn: Create a fashion outfit flat lay photograph. Arrange a top, pants or skirt, shoes, bag, and accessories on a clean background according to a complete outfit logic. Fabric folds should be natural, textile texture clear, and colors harmonious. Use an overhead or slightly angled overhead camera, leaving enough blank space for adding Chinese labels later, but do not generate real text. Lighting should be soft and even with light shadows, like a brand lookbook or e-commerce styling image. Avoid distorted garments, incorrect collars or cuffs, unreasonable accessory scale, messy background, random text, and heavy filters.
subject: clothing

author: Jisudeng
title: 新年国风商业视觉
description: 适合春节活动、品牌海报、节日社媒图。
promptZh: 生成一张新年国风商业视觉底图。画面包含朱红、米白、墨色和少量金色点缀，中心可以是灯笼、窗花、礼盒、梅枝、祥云、山水层次或传统建筑剪影。构图要现代、干净、有留白，适合后期添加中文标题和活动信息，但不要生成真实文字或书法。风格融合传统纹样和现代商业插画，质感高级不过度金光。避免廉价贴图、杂乱边框、乱码书法、过度喜庆堆砌、生肖错误和不统一纹样。
promptEn: Create a Chinese New Year commercial visual background. Use vermilion, warm white, ink black, and a small amount of gold accent. The central motif can be lanterns, paper-cut window patterns, gift boxes, plum blossoms, auspicious clouds, layered landscapes, or traditional architecture silhouettes. The composition should be modern, clean, and spacious, suitable for adding Chinese headlines and campaign information later, but do not generate real text or calligraphy. Blend traditional patterns with modern commercial illustration and a premium texture without excessive gold shine. Avoid cheap sticker collage, messy borders, garbled calligraphy, overloaded festive elements, incorrect zodiac symbols, and inconsistent patterns.
subject: festival

author: Jisudeng
title: 水彩绘本场景
description: 适合儿童绘本、温柔插画、故事封面。
promptZh: 绘制一张温柔水彩绘本场景。画面中有一个清晰的小故事瞬间，例如孩子在窗边看雨、动物朋友在森林野餐、小船经过月光湖面或小屋门口点亮暖灯。使用真实纸张纹理、柔和水彩晕染、轻盈线稿和低饱和色彩。构图要有叙事焦点，边缘保留呼吸感，适合绘本跨页或封面。不要生成文字，人物和动物表情要温暖自然。避免过度数字插画质感、脏污纸面、透视混乱、恐怖氛围和过碎细节。
promptEn: Paint a gentle watercolor children's book scene. Show a clear story moment, such as a child watching rain by a window, animal friends having a forest picnic, a small boat crossing a moonlit lake, or a warm light glowing at a cottage door. Use real paper texture, soft watercolor bleeding, light linework, and low-saturation colors. The composition should have a narrative focal point with breathable edges, suitable for a picture book spread or cover. Do not generate text, and keep human or animal expressions warm and natural. Avoid overly digital illustration texture, dirty paper, chaotic perspective, horror mood, and overly fragmented details.
subject: story-scene

author: Jisudeng
title: 像素角色动作表
description: 适合横版游戏、独立游戏、像素动画参考。
promptZh: 生成一张像素角色动作表。画面以整齐网格展示同一个角色的多个动作帧，包括站立、行走、奔跑、跳跃、攻击、受击和胜利动作。角色比例、服装、发型和主色保持一致，每个动作都有清晰轮廓和像素颗粒，背景透明或纯色，不生成文字。像素大小统一，色板限制，边缘硬朗，适合游戏制作参考。避免角色造型不一致、像素模糊、动作帧互相遮挡、过高分辨率插画感和随机标注文字。
promptEn: Create a pixel character sprite sheet. Show the same character in a clean grid with multiple action frames, including idle, walking, running, jumping, attacking, taking damage, and victory pose. Keep character proportions, clothing, hairstyle, and main colors consistent. Each pose should have a clear silhouette and crisp pixel texture, with transparent or solid-color background and no text. Pixel size should be consistent, palette limited, and edges hard, suitable for game production reference. Avoid inconsistent character design, blurry pixels, overlapping frames, high-resolution illustration feel, and random label text.
subject: character

author: Jisudeng
title: 3D 品牌吉祥物
description: 适合品牌 IP、APP 空状态、客服形象和活动页。
promptZh: 设计一个现代 3D 品牌吉祥物角色。角色外形友好、轮廓简单、有一个明确记忆点，例如耳机、闪电符号、圆形背包、发光徽章或独特帽子。材质为柔和塑料、布料或轻微磨砂材质，颜色明亮但不过饱和。角色姿态像在欢迎用户或展示功能，表情积极可信。背景为浅色干净空间，可加入少量功能图标占位，但不要生成文字。角色要适合缩小成头像或空状态插画。避免复杂毛发、恐怖表情、过度反光、真实品牌标识和不协调肢体。
promptEn: Design a modern 3D brand mascot character. The character should be friendly, simple in silhouette, and have one memorable feature such as headphones, a lightning symbol, a round backpack, a glowing badge, or a unique hat. Use soft plastic, fabric, or slightly matte materials, with bright but not oversaturated colors. The pose should feel welcoming or as if presenting a feature, with a positive and trustworthy expression. Use a clean light background with a few optional functional icon placeholders, but do not generate text. The character should work when scaled down as an avatar or empty-state illustration. Avoid complex fur, frightening expressions, excessive reflections, real brand marks, and awkward limbs.
subject: mascot

author: Jisudeng
title: 活动排版海报版式
description: 适合讲座、展览、发布会、课程活动的可编辑海报底图。
promptZh: 设计一张现代中文活动海报版式底图。画面包含清晰的大标题区域、副标题区域、时间地点信息区、嘉宾或产品图区域和行动按钮位置，但不要生成真实文字，只用抽象占位线、色块或不可读文字块表示信息层级。构图强调网格、对齐、留白和视觉节奏。背景可以是纯色、轻微纸纹、简洁几何图形或低对比照片纹理。风格专业、克制、适合后期编辑。避免乱码文字、真实品牌名、过多装饰、排版拥挤和难以替换的文字元素。
promptEn: Design a modern Chinese event poster layout background. Include a clear large headline area, subtitle area, time and location information area, guest or product image area, and call-to-action button position, but do not generate real text. Use abstract placeholder lines, color blocks, or unreadable text blocks to represent information hierarchy. Emphasize grid, alignment, negative space, and visual rhythm. The background can be solid color, subtle paper texture, simple geometry, or low-contrast photo texture. The style should be professional, restrained, and suitable for later editing. Avoid garbled text, real brand names, excessive decoration, crowded layout, and text elements that are hard to replace.
subject: layout

author: Jisudeng
title: 播客封面视觉
description: 适合播客、音频节目、知识栏目封面。
promptZh: 生成一张播客封面视觉底图。画面中心可以是麦克风、耳机、人物剪影、声波抽象图形或栏目主题物件，构图为正方形，主体清楚，背景有安静但有辨识度的氛围。预留节目名称和期数标题位置，但不要生成真实文字。风格可以是现代摄影、矢量插画或 3D 图形，整体要适合在小尺寸封面中识别。色彩对比清楚但不刺眼。避免乱码文字、复杂小元素、低清噪点、真实品牌 Logo 和主题不明确。
promptEn: Create a podcast cover visual background. The center may show a microphone, headphones, character silhouette, abstract sound wave graphic, or an object related to the show theme. Use a square composition with a clear subject and a calm but recognizable atmosphere. Reserve space for the show name and episode title, but do not generate real text. The style may be modern photography, vector illustration, or 3D graphics, and must remain recognizable at small cover size. Use clear contrast without harsh colors. Avoid garbled text, complex tiny elements, low-resolution noise, real brand logos, and unclear themes.
subject: cover

author: Jisudeng
title: 音乐专辑封面
description: 适合音乐封面、歌单视觉、情绪概念图。
promptZh: 创作一张音乐专辑封面底图。画面以一个强情绪主题为核心，例如雨夜车窗、孤独海岸、霓虹走廊、复古房间、空旷公路或抽象光影人物。构图为正方形，主体简洁，情绪明确，预留歌名和艺人名排版区域但不要生成真实文字。光线和色彩要服务音乐氛围，可以偏电影感、复古、梦幻或极简。画面要有记忆点，适合缩小后仍可识别。避免乱码文字、随机乐器堆砌、过度滤镜、低清噪点和主题不统一。
promptEn: Create a music album cover background. Build the image around a strong emotional theme such as a rainy car window, lonely coast, neon corridor, vintage room, empty road, or abstract light-and-shadow figure. Use a square composition with a simple subject and clear mood. Reserve space for song title and artist name layout, but do not generate real text. Lighting and color should serve the musical atmosphere, whether cinematic, retro, dreamy, or minimal. The image should have a memorable focal point and remain recognizable when scaled down. Avoid garbled text, random piles of instruments, excessive filters, low-resolution noise, and inconsistent theme.
subject: cover

author: Jisudeng
title: 科技发布会舞台
description: 适合发布会海报、活动视觉、科技品牌宣传。
promptZh: 生成一张科技发布会舞台视觉。画面中有大型 LED 屏幕、简洁舞台、灯光线条和中心展示区域，整体像真实发布会现场但没有可读文字。舞台中央可以有产品剪影、抽象科技符号或留白展示位。光线高级克制，颜色以深色背景配合蓝、白、银或少量品牌色强调。构图横向宽幅，适合官网 banner 或活动主视觉。避免随机英文、真实品牌名、过度科幻、廉价光效、舞台结构不合理和杂乱观众。
promptEn: Create a technology conference stage visual. Include a large LED screen, clean stage, lighting lines, and a central display area, resembling a real launch event but without readable text. The center may contain a product silhouette, abstract technology symbol, or clean presentation space. Lighting should be premium and restrained, using a dark background with blue, white, silver, or a small amount of brand color accent. Use a horizontal wide composition suitable for a website banner or event hero image. Avoid random English text, real brand names, excessive sci-fi styling, cheap lighting effects, impossible stage structure, and messy audience details.
subject: stage

author: Jisudeng
title: 美妆护肤产品场景
description: 适合护肤品主视觉、电商详情、社媒种草图。
promptZh: 生成一张美妆护肤产品场景图。产品瓶罐摆放在干净台面上，周围有少量水滴、花瓣、石材、玻璃、丝绸或植物元素，突出清洁、保湿、温和或高端科技感。产品标签不要生成真实可读文字，可使用简洁占位块。光线柔和通透，材质细节清楚，玻璃和塑料反光真实不过曝。构图适合电商详情页和社媒封面，主体明确，有留白。避免产品变形、乱码文字、过多道具、廉价粉色堆砌和不真实液体效果。
promptEn: Create a beauty and skincare product scene. Place bottles or jars on a clean surface, surrounded by a few elements such as water droplets, petals, stone, glass, silk, or plants to suggest cleanliness, hydration, gentleness, or premium technology. Product labels must not contain real readable text; use simple placeholder blocks instead. Lighting should be soft and translucent, with clear material detail and realistic glass or plastic reflections without overexposure. The composition should work for e-commerce detail pages and social covers, with a clear subject and some blank space. Avoid product distortion, garbled text, too many props, cheap pink overload, and unrealistic liquid effects.
subject: skincare

author: Jisudeng
title: 汽车内饰细节
description: 适合汽车用品、车载设备、质感宣传图。
promptZh: 生成一张汽车内饰细节摄影。镜头聚焦方向盘、中控屏、座椅纹理、车载设备或香薰等主体，周围展示真实车内材质，例如皮革、金属、玻璃和软包。光线来自车窗侧面，产生高级柔和反光，背景轻微虚化但保留车内空间感。画面适合汽车用品或车载产品宣传，主体清晰，比例真实。不要生成品牌 Logo、车牌、随机文字、过度反光、错误仪表结构或不合理空间。
promptEn: Create an automotive interior detail photograph. Focus on a steering wheel, center display, seat texture, in-car device, fragrance product, or similar subject, while showing realistic interior materials such as leather, metal, glass, and soft trim. Light should enter from the side window, creating premium soft reflections. The background may be slightly blurred while preserving a sense of cabin space. The image should work for automotive accessories or in-car product promotion, with a clear subject and realistic scale. Do not generate brand logos, license plates, random text, excessive reflections, incorrect dashboard structure, or impossible space.
subject: automotive

author: Jisudeng
title: 宠物用品生活方式图
description: 适合宠物用品、电商详情、社媒内容。
promptZh: 生成一张宠物用品生活方式摄影。画面中有猫或狗在真实家庭环境中自然使用宠物窝、玩具、食盆、牵引绳或清洁用品。宠物表情自然友好，姿态真实，产品清楚可见且不被遮挡。室内光线柔和，背景干净温暖，有生活气息但不杂乱。画面适合电商详情和社媒种草。不要生成文字、水印、变形动物、过度拟人表情、脏乱环境或不合理产品尺寸。
promptEn: Create a pet product lifestyle photograph. Show a cat or dog naturally using a pet bed, toy, bowl, leash, or cleaning product in a real home environment. The pet expression should be natural and friendly, with a realistic pose, and the product clearly visible without being blocked. Use soft indoor light and a clean warm background with a lived-in feeling but no clutter. The image should work for e-commerce detail pages and social recommendations. Do not generate text, watermarks, distorted animals, overly human expressions, messy environments, or unrealistic product size.
subject: pet-product

author: Jisudeng
title: 健康科普插画
description: 适合健康知识、医疗科普、保险和服务介绍，避免具体医疗结论。
promptZh: 生成一张健康科普插画。主题可以表现身体护理、心理健康、睡眠管理、运动恢复、家庭医生服务或健康数据管理。画面使用亲和、可信、干净的现代插画风格，包含人物、设备、图标、植物或柔和医疗场景元素。构图应有明确主视觉和信息留白，不生成真实文字、诊断结果或药品名称。色彩清爽，避免恐惧和病痛视觉。不要生成血腥画面、真实医院品牌、乱码文字、具体处方、夸张病症和不适合大众科普的图像。
promptEn: Create a health education illustration. The theme may represent body care, mental health, sleep management, exercise recovery, family doctor services, or health data management. Use a friendly, credible, clean modern illustration style with people, devices, icons, plants, or soft medical scene elements. The composition should have a clear main visual and space for information, without generating real text, diagnosis results, or medicine names. Colors should feel fresh and reassuring, avoiding fear or illness-heavy visuals. Do not generate gore, real hospital brands, garbled text, specific prescriptions, exaggerated symptoms, or imagery unsuitable for public health education.
subject: health

author: Jisudeng
title: 工业设备产品渲染
description: 适合机械设备、B2B 产品、工业官网视觉。
promptZh: 生成一张工业设备产品渲染图。主体为机械设备、仪器、服务器、传感器、工具或模块化零件，放在干净的工业棚拍环境中。设备结构清楚，金属、橡胶、玻璃、塑料和螺丝细节真实，边缘硬朗，比例合理。光线采用冷暖结合的专业产品渲染，背景可以有轻微工业场景暗示但不能抢主体。画面适合 B2B 官网和产品手册，不生成文字、品牌标识、编号或水印。避免结构不可能、零件错位、过度科幻、脏乱背景和低质材质。
promptEn: Create an industrial equipment product render. The subject can be machinery, an instrument, server, sensor, tool, or modular component placed in a clean industrial studio environment. Structure must be clear, with realistic metal, rubber, glass, plastic, and screw details, crisp edges, and reasonable scale. Use professional product rendering light with a balanced cool-warm tone. The background may hint at an industrial scene but must not compete with the subject. The image should work for a B2B website or product brochure, with no text, brand marks, serial numbers, or watermarks. Avoid impossible structure, misplaced parts, excessive sci-fi styling, messy backgrounds, and low-quality materials.
subject: industrial-product

author: Jisudeng
title: 旅行目的地首图
description: 适合旅游攻略、城市宣传、酒店民宿内容。
promptZh: 生成一张旅行目的地首图。画面展示一个明确地点氛围，例如海边小镇、山间公路、老城街巷、湖畔民宿、沙漠营地或城市天际线。构图要有前景、中景和远景层次，光线为清晨、傍晚或晴朗自然光，色彩真实耐看。画面应适合旅游攻略封面，预留标题空间但不生成真实文字。整体要让人有想去的冲动，同时保持真实可信。避免过度 HDR、假天空、拥挤游客、乱码招牌、地标结构错误和廉价明信片滤镜。
promptEn: Create a travel destination hero image. Show a clear destination atmosphere such as a seaside town, mountain road, old city lane, lakeside homestay, desert camp, or city skyline. The composition should have foreground, midground, and background depth. Use morning, evening, or bright natural daylight with realistic and durable colors. The image should work as a travel guide cover, leaving space for a title but generating no real text. It should make the viewer want to visit while remaining credible. Avoid excessive HDR, fake skies, crowded tourists, garbled signs, incorrect landmark structures, and cheap postcard filters.
subject: travel

author: Jisudeng
title: 职业个人品牌照
description: 适合求职头像、专家介绍、个人主页。
promptZh: 生成一张职业个人品牌照片。主体穿着简洁得体，处于明亮办公空间、书房、工作室或浅色背景前，姿态自然，表情自信友好。画面应体现专业可信和亲和力，适合简历、专家介绍和个人主页。光线柔和均匀，肤色真实，五官清楚，服装细节自然。构图为半身或胸像，保留少量环境信息但不杂乱。不要生成文字、证件水印、夸张商务道具、过度磨皮、变形手部和虚假背景。
promptEn: Create a professional personal brand portrait. The subject wears simple appropriate clothing and stands or sits in a bright office, study, studio, or in front of a light background, with a natural pose and confident friendly expression. The image should communicate professionalism, trust, and approachability, suitable for a resume, expert bio, or personal homepage. Lighting should be soft and even, skin tone realistic, facial features clear, and clothing details natural. Use a half-body or bust composition with a little environmental context but no clutter. Do not generate text, ID watermarks, exaggerated business props, over-smoothed skin, distorted hands, or fake-looking backgrounds.
subject: portrait

author: Jisudeng
subject: portrait
title: 头像 · 干净商业
description: 适合年轻用户相关的头像创作，强调清爽、可信、适合直接用于品牌物料。
promptZh: 创作一张头像 · 干净商业视觉图。主体为真实自然的人物头像，面部清晰，眼神自然，服装简洁，背景干净。主题围绕年轻用户展开，画面需要有明确主体、干净背景、稳定构图和可直接使用的商业完成度。请明确处理主体比例、前景与背景层次、光线方向、色彩关系、材质细节和留白区域；整体气质要求清爽、可信、适合直接用于品牌物料。如果画面需要后期加标题或卖点，请预留清楚区域但不要生成真实文字。避免随机文字、水印、错误品牌标识、变形五官、错误肢体、低清晰度、过度磨皮、过度锐化、杂乱背景和廉价模板感。
promptEn: Create a profile avatar - clean commercial visual. The subject is a realistic profile portrait with clear facial features, natural eyes, simple clothing, and a clean background. The theme is young audience. The image needs a clear subject, clean background, stable composition, and commercial polish ready for use. Carefully handle subject scale, foreground and background layering, light direction, color relationship, material details, and negative space. The overall feeling should be clean, credible, ready for brand use. If later headline or selling-point copy is expected, reserve clean space but do not generate actual text. Avoid random text, watermarks, incorrect logos, distorted faces, incorrect limbs, low clarity, over-smoothed skin, over-sharpening, cluttered backgrounds, and cheap template aesthetics.
